## Change

Give the change and its cause.

## Checks

- [ ] `task check` has a satisfactory result.
- [ ] The change has no personal data or secrets.
- [ ] Each included asset has pinned rights records and a SHA-256.
- [ ] Each startup download has the same asset checks as an included file.
- [ ] The client wheel has no server runtime.

This project is experimental and has no release. Publication must have operator approval.
